mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place ( user_id, title, address, detail_address, info, place_type, place_area, max_dog_count, option_small_dog, option_medium_dog, option_large_dog, option_home_cam, option_real_time_photo, option_yard, option_walk_service, option_etc, option_text, hour_price, day_price, place_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{info}, #{placeType}, #{placeArea}, #{maxDogCount}, #{optionSmallDog}, #{optionMediumDog}, #{optionLargeDog}, #{optionHomeCam}, #{optionRealTimePhoto}, #{optionYard}, #{optionWalkService}, #{optionEtc}, #{optionText}, #{hourPrice}, #{dayPrice}, #{placeStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, place_status AS status FROM place WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
